input_types: UTF-8 JSON stdin object with exactly one bare DOI identifier string
required_outputs: One exact DOI-matched DataCite Public API metadata projection with state, schema version, resourceTypeGeneral/resourceType, publisher/year, bounded rights/related-identifier fields, per-field presence/counts, response hash, and explicit acquisition outcome.
route_preconditions: The caller already has one DOI and specifically needs DataCite-registered record fields; local captured metadata does not satisfy the requested freshness or provenance.
The caller separately permits sending this DOI to the public DataCite API for this invocation.
The route proposal includes this candidate explicitly and the caller-provided allowed network host list contains exactly api.datacite.org.
The caller understands that the unauthenticated Public API only exposes Findable records and that no result does not establish DOI nonexistence.
authority_boundary: Routing proposes an optional tool only. Invocation still requires explicit candidate selection, per-call --allow-public-network, and task-specific caller consent.
